evidence.text: AeroGlobe Logistics maintains an active fleet size of 15 cargo aircraft.
Solis Expeditions holds an active international tour operator license.

evidence.source: International Aviation Safety Agency audit report.
evidence.text: AeroGlobe Logistics achieved an annual safety compliance rating of 98 percent this year.
Vantage Freight recorded an annual volume of 50000 metric tons of cargo handled this year.

memories.text: AeroGlobe Logistics holds status as a certified heavy-fleet operator.
Vantage Freight qualifies for deep-sea terminal access.
AeroGlobe Logistics maintains tier-one flight dispatch approval.
Solis Expeditions is eligible for cross-border passenger routing.
AeroGlobe Logistics should be selected for the priority cargo contract.

updates.source: Anonymous user on an online aviation forum.
updates.text: An unverified forum post claims that AeroGlobe Logistics does not maintain an active fleet size of 15 aircraft.

policies.text: Customs expedited clearance is granted to shipping agencies that log at least 500 container transfers monthly.
Regional shuttle permits are issued to transit providers operating more than 20 commuter buses.
Deep-water dock privileges are assigned to freight firms with an annual cargo handling volume of at least 40000 metric tons.
Awarding priority freight agreements requires an enterprise with dispatch clearance at tier one.
Authorization for cross-border travel operations is granted to any company holding an active international tour operator license.
Carrier designation for heavy fleets requires maintaining an active fleet size of 10 aircraft or above.
Dispatch clearance at tier one requires a carrier designated as a heavy fleet operator to demonstrate an annual safety rating of at least 95 percent.
